Confirmed: `hooks.ts` matches the pattern exactly (same shape as `withRetry.ts:795-798`). `bingAdapter.ts` doesn't — the error there comes from `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` on a single regex-match array read, not a re-invoked narrowed guard, so it goes to `skipped`.
